intro: Grab a golf club. Let's warm up. Starting in five, four, three, two, one.
outro: Warmup complete. Have a great round.

exercises.name: Leg swings, front to back
exercises.announce: Leg swings, front to back. Thirty seconds each side. Begin.

exercises.name: Leg swings, side to side, toe forward
exercises.announce: Next: leg swings, side to side, toe pointed forward. Thirty seconds each side.

exercises.name: Leg swings, side to side, toe rotating
exercises.announce: Next: leg swings, side to side, with toe rotation. Thirty seconds each side.

exercises.name: Chest openers
exercises.announce: Set the club down. Next: chest openers. Thirty seconds.

exercises.name: Thoracic twists
exercises.announce: Pick up your club. Next: thoracic twists. Thirty seconds each side.

exercises.name: Hip hinge with lat stretch
exercises.announce: Next: hip hinge with lat stretch. Thirty seconds.

exercises.name: Hip openers
exercises.announce: Next: hip openers. Thirty seconds each side.

exercises.name: Hamstring sweeps
exercises.announce: Set the club down. Next: hamstring sweeps, alternating legs. Thirty seconds.

exercises.name: Step back lunge
exercises.announce: Pick up your club. Next: step back lunge, alternating legs. Forty-five seconds.

exercises.name: Side bend with toe tap
exercises.announce: Set the club down. Next: side bend with toe tap, alternating. Thirty seconds.

exercises.name: Side lunge with lat stretch
exercises.announce: Next: side lunge with lat stretch, alternating. Thirty seconds.

exercises.name: Speed skater, high
exercises.announce: Next: speed skater, high, alternating. Thirty seconds.

exercises.name: Speed skater, low
exercises.announce: Next: speed skater, low, alternating. Thirty seconds.

exercises.name: Cross body, elbow to knee
exercises.announce: Next: cross body, elbow to knee. Thirty seconds.

exercises.name: Full upper body twist
exercises.announce: Next: full upper body twist. Thirty seconds.
